eqtl.release: GTEx V10 SuSiE eQTL, GENCODE39 GRCh38
eqtl.tissue_selection: distinct blood, hepatic and neural compartments; selected before fitting
eqtl.matching: 1:1 without replacement within gene, chromosome, MAF bin and absolute TSS-distance bin; SNVs only; unique genomic positions
eqtl.label_scope: exploratory high-versus-low posterior among released credible-set variants; low-PIP controls are not confirmed noncausal
eqtl.ld_matching: unavailable in compact release; do not claim matched LD

hg008.task: external insertion versus deletion, INS=1; not breakpoint localization
hg008.mapping: unchanged manuscript endpoint normalizer and mapper; report overlap-only sensitivity
hg008.uncertainty: paired chromosome-fold then seed bootstrap; tiny single-genome sample, descriptive only
